data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 193.5m (2017: GBP 140.2m) is an improvement of GBP 9.6m (2017: deterioration of GBP 19.1m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments across the significant classes.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were GBP 385.226m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net adverse re-estimation on prior years of approximately GBP 8.684m (about 2.25% of opening gross reserves), driven by adverse movements in some older underwriting years (notably 2014 and 2016) partially offset by releases in other years. The managing agent attributes overall prior-year movement to favourable claims development across significant classes and to lower exposure to catastrophe losses in 2018; the report also highlights changes in reinsurance purchasing and ceded ratios as relevant factors.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 193.5m (2017: GBP 140.2m) is an improvement of GBP 9.6m (2017: deterioration of GBP 19.1m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to favourable developments across the significant classes.

This follows lower exposure to catastrophe losses in 2018 and is testament to the significant work undertaken over the past 2 years in re-underwriting the portfolio and more recently selectively renewing the business transferred from Syndicates 5820 and 1206.

The reduction in the ceded ratio is driven by efficiencies realised in purchasing the combined programme, a reduction in reinstatement premiums compared to the 2017 calendar year following the lower incidence of catastrophe claims and changes in the business mix.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to Property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (GBP 8.684m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 36) by comparing the latest estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years up to 2016, per the prescribed methodology. The report also provides a narrative (and a net figure of GBP 9.6m improvement included in net claims incurred) but that net figure is after reinsurance and therefore was not used as the primary gross PYD source. No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior years were cited in the text. Opening reserves taken from the Statement of Financial Position (gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2017 / 1 Jan 2018).
